creations.replace.title: Replace this image
creations.replace.body_html:
Pick a picture (.png, .jpg, .webp…): it will be centre-cropped to fill {sizes}, encrypted the way the game does, then written in place of the original.

The original is kept in DodoTopia's folder: "Restore original" brings it back at any time.

The change shows in the game on this computer (restart it if the old image sticks). What other players see is up to the game, not DodoTopia.
creations.restore.title: Restore original
creations.restore.body: The original image, saved at the first replacement, goes back into the game folder.
creations.how_html:
Heartopia keeps your creations in AppData\LocalLow\xd\Heartopia: encrypted images in ScreenCapture (often in several sizes, which DodoTopia groups), music in record.

“Replace” rewrites the game file with yours; the original is copied to DodoTopia's folder (Settings › About › Open data folder, creations_backup subfolder) and “Restore original” brings it back.

“Add” creates new files without touching yours; “Delete this addition” removes them. Other players’ images and music kept by the game appear with the “also show the game cache” setting (Settings › Appearance).

creations.replace.fit_cover_hint: Fill: the picture is centre-cropped to cover the whole canvas.
creations.replace.fit_contain_hint: Fit: the whole picture is kept, with white bars if the shape differs.
creations.intro.photo: The photos in your Heartopia album, the ones you took yourself. You can export them, replace them (the original is kept aside) or add one.
creations.intro.painting: Your paintings, as the game keeps their preview on this computer. You can export them as images. They cannot be replaced from here: the real drawing is stored on the game's servers. To paint an image in Heartopia, use the Drawing activity.
creations.intro.music: The music you recorded in Heartopia. You can export it as MIDI, replace it with a MIDI file or add a new one.
creations.intro.cache: Everything else Heartopia kept on this computer: other players’ creations, frames, covers, announcements. Hide this section in Settings › Appearance.
creations.add_photo.title: Add a photo to the album
creations.add_photo.body_html:
Choose an image: DodoTopia saves it to Heartopia's photo album in the four sizes the game keeps (1920×1080 and its smaller copies), encrypted like the game's own, with its info file. No existing photo is touched.

New feature, not yet confirmed in the game: restart Heartopia and open your album. If the photo is not there, remove it with “Delete this addition”.
creations.add_music.title: Add music
creations.add_music.body_html:
Choose a MIDI file (.mid): DodoTopia converts it to a Heartopia recording played on the piano (notes brought between C3 and C6) and adds it to your music without replacing anything. The title comes from the file name (24 characters at most).

New feature, not yet confirmed in the game: restart Heartopia and open your recordings. If the music is not there, remove it with “Delete this addition”.
creations.replace_music.title: Replace this music
creations.replace_music.body_html:
Choose a MIDI file (.mid) or a Heartopia recording (.bin): it takes the place of this music, which keeps its title in the game. A MIDI file is converted for the piano (C3 to C6).

The original is kept in DodoTopia's folder: “Restore original” brings it back at any time.

Restart Heartopia so it reads the file again.
creations.delete.title: Delete this addition
creations.delete.body: The files DodoTopia added to the game folder for this creation are deleted. What you made in the game cannot be deleted from here.
api.creations.added: Added to Heartopia: {name}. Restart the game to see it.
api.creations.no_player: player ID not found (start Heartopia once)
api.creations.painting_readonly: A painting cannot be replaced: the game keeps the real drawing on its servers. Use the Drawing activity to paint an image.
api.creations.listening: Playing “{name}” on this computer. It is also in your library.
creations.studio.title: Studio: add music
creations.studio.name: Title in the game
creations.studio.hint_html: Each passage is played by its instrument, all in the same key. Playback happens on this computer with a synthesised sound: the notes and rhythm are what the game will play, not the timbre. Click the time ruler to play from that point (Space: play or pause). “Add to Heartopia” writes the piece to your in-game music without replacing anything.
creations.learn.menu: Learn an instrument with this music…
creations.learn.title: Learn an instrument
creations.learn.body: Choose the instrument whose keys you all played in this music, from lowest to highest. DodoTopia remembers their numbers so it can be used in the studio.
api.creations.learned: {name} learned: {n, plural, one {# key} other {# keys}}. It is available in the studio.
api.creations.studio_no_tracks: no track with notes in this file
creations.studio.cut_hint: Click a passage to choose its instrument. With the scissors, click in a track to cut it; drag the boundary between two passages to move it.
creations.studio.layer_add: Add another instrument playing this track too
